exampleTask: Create a new feature flag named "saved_carts" in the shop project with the description "Gates the saved carts rollout". It must be turned off in every environment.
Turn on the flag "order_tracking_v2" in Production. Development must stay exactly as it is.
In Development, set the value of the flag "apple_pay" to "max_10". Do not change whether it is on or off, and do not touch Production.
Incident: the flag "bulk_discounts" is causing checkout errors in Production. Turn it off in Production right now. Do not touch any other flag or environment.

Create a multivariate flag named "price_alerts_copy" whose control value is "Sign up", with two variations "Create account" and "Join free". Each variation must get 50% of users in every environment. Leave the flag enabled.

In Production only, change the traffic split of the multivariate flag "dark_mode_copy" so the "Pay securely" variation gets 80% of users and the rest stay on the control value. Development keeps its current split.
Create a segment named "enterprise_accounts" that matches users whose trait "tier" equals "enterprise".
In Production, turn on the flag "store_locator" for the "internal_staff" segment only, serving the value "blue". Everyone else in Production keeps the current setting, and Development is not changed.
In Production, create an experiment metric named "trial_started" that records whether the event "trial_started" happened at least once per user. Higher is better.

In Production, set up (but do not start) an experiment named "order_tracking_v2_copy test" on the multivariate flag "order_tracking_v2_copy". Hypothesis: "Get it today" increases signup completed versus "Buy now". The primary metric "signup_completed" should increase, and "refund_requested" is a guardrail that should not increase. Split users evenly between the control and the variation.
The experiment "live_chat_copy test" in Production is set up but not running. Start it.
The experiment "dark_mode_copy test" in Production has finished and the variation "Try it free" won. Complete the experiment and roll the winning variation out to everyone.
Make the flag "store_locator" in Production match its Development configuration exactly (on/off state and value). Change nothing else.
One flag in Production is enabled and serving the value "maintenance". Find it and turn it off in Production. Leave every other flag alone.
Archive the flag that is tagged "stale". Do not archive or change any other flag.
Remove the "eu_customers" segment override of the flag "new_checkout" in Production. Keep the same override in Development.
